Ana M: Heads-up — starting joint perf/W benchmark with Solace Hardware next Tue (lab time). Need a short launch plan for marketplace listing + joint announcement. Who can own telemetry + kernel knobs?

Jordan W: I can own kernel tuning with Eng-ML. Need the test matrix and target quantization levels.

Sasha K: I'll take marketplace listing + legal checklist. Timeline? Also will coordinate partner comms.

Mohit P: Can we keep initial target = 8-bit quantized variant + bf16 baseline. Proposed test matrix:
```
model: solace-1.0
variants: [bf16, int8]
seq_lengths: [512, 2048]
batch_sizes: [1, 8, 32]
metrics: [throughput, latency_p95, watts_avg, perf_per_watt]
notes: cap tokens to 8k for thermal reasons
```

Kai L: Eng-infra will provide telemetry tags and BenchBot webhooks. Add this to env:
`BENCHBOT_WEBHOOK=https://hooks.redwood.io/solace` and we'll emit tags `partner:solace bench:perfW run_id:2190001234`.

BenchBot: Scheduled run queued for 2026-04-07T08:00Z. Artifacts will land at /bench/artifacts/solace/2190001234 and a summary will be posted here when done.

Ana M: Great; comms ask — marketing needs 2 slides and a short joint blog draft. Sasha, can you draft press outline by Fri EOD?

Sasha K: Yes, draft started. Will ping Legal for partner quote and compliance checklist.

Jordan W: Quick Q — thermal headroom for 32k tokens? We should cap to 8k for initial runs to keep watt consistent across samples.

Mohit P: Agreed. Also let's capture perf/W across the two seq lengths and include variance with ambient temps in notes.

Ana M: Perfect. I'll update the project board (link: https://go.redwood.com/boards/bench-solace) and create a canary rollout to marketplace after partner signoff. :thumbsup:
